metadata.title: Mandatory Breach Notification

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business Compliance Management – ensures legally required security and privacy breach notifications are identified, governed, and executed by authorized institutional functions.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Mandatory Breach Notification – architecture pattern governing statutory notification obligations following security or privacy breaches.

props.name: data-domain
props.remarks: Records and Governance Data – includes breach records, notification evidence, regulator correspondence, and incident documentation.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Digital Communication Technologies – technologies used to deliver breach notifications to regulators, affected individuals, and institutional stakeholders.

links.text: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada – Breach Notification Guidance
links.remarks: Authoritative guidance on breach notification obligations under PIPEDA, including reporting to regulators and notification of affected individuals.
Proposed Canadian legislative changes strengthening privacy obligations and breach notification requirements; monitored for future impact.

metadata.remarks: The Mandatory Breach Notification pattern defines regulatory obligations and governance expectations for notifying regulators, affected individuals, and institutional authorities following a security or privacy breach. It establishes compliance scope and assessability without embedding timelines, thresholds, legal interpretation, or incident response procedures.

components.title: Breach Identification and Materiality Assessment
components.description: Ensures that potential security or privacy incidents are evaluated to determine whether statutory breach notification obligations are triggered.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Failure to recognize or acknowledge notifiable breaches.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance decision-making and policy enforcement for breach determination.

components.title: Authorized Breach Notification
components.description: Ensures that breach notifications are issued only by authorized institutional functions and in accordance with legal and policy authority.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Issuance of unauthorized or misleading breach notifications.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Role-based authorization and controlled notification authority.

components.title: Multi-Party Notification Obligations
components.description: Affirms that breach notification obligations may require communication with regulators, affected individuals, and other parties as defined by applicable law.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Incomplete or selective notification that fails to meet statutory requirements.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance oversight ensuring notification scope aligns with legal obligations.

components.title: Breach Notification Recordkeeping
components.description: Ensures that breach determinations, notifications issued, and related decisions are documented and retained for accountability and regulatory review.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression or deletion of breach notification evidence.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Auditability and evidence preservation supporting compliance verification.

components.title: Regulatory Change Monitoring
components.description: Affirms that evolving breach notification legislation and guidance (e.g., proposed changes under Bill C‑27) are monitored and assessed for impact.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Non-compliance due to failure to track regulatory change.
